The '''Force Priestesses''', also known as the '''Five Priestesses''', were a group of mysterious [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who held the secret to [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]].

==History==
[[File:Force_Priestesses.png|thumb|left|350px|The five Priestesses look upon Yoda]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] encountered the Force Priestesses on a [[Wellspring of Life/Legends|planet]] in the heart of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], where they put him through a series of trials. The Priestesses represented serenity, joy, anger, confusion, and sadness, respectively, and nothing was found behind their white masks.

The Priestesses existed in a state between the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] and the [[Cosmic Force/Legends|Cosmic Force]], and they could manifest themselves before the living at will.

The trials they put Yoda through forced him to face the personification of his hubris, resist great temptation, and finally, travel to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], to pass the ultimate test, which was beyond the Priestesses' control.

When Yoda's trials were complete, the Priestesses deemed the Jedi Grand Master able to retain his identity after death.

==Behind the scenes==
The Five Priestesses first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]].
